attempts.text:
**The window starts on a single spine column.** Column 0, `ydgC`, a GlpM family protein, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names it in 99% of calls, with 0.02 bits.

**Then 79 fork and variable columns open up**, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 72% of calls, named in 37 to 99%. The most hesitant column is 31, 1.46 bits, in a region of plasticity in 55% of calls; the fewest named is column 7, 37%. A second branch of 68 families runs through columns 1 to 68, carried by 11 to 13% of chromosomes, and a second branch of 4 families through columns 70 to 73, carried by 13 to 17%.

**The forks carry their own families.** `folM`, `ydgI`, `ydgH`, `pntA` and `pntB` are persistent at 86%, then `tqsA` at 82%, and `mdtJ` to `mdtI`, [[multidrug and spermidine efflux]], at 85 to 86%. The `mar` genes, `marB` to `marC`, [[multiple antibiotic resistance]], sit at 43 to 47%, and `lsrB` to `lsrK`, [[substrate binding and transport]], at 23 to 25%. `hipB` and `hipA`, [[toxin-antitoxin system]], are at 26 to 29%.

**The model names genes readily on the spine and hesitates in the forks.** Persistent calls are named in 96%, at 0.21 bits; cloud calls in 20%, at 3.78 bits. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 1.25 against 0.23 bits, and names fewer genes, 78% against 92%. The window ends at column 79, a phage minor tail protein L, in 20% of chromosomes.

label: ydgC
facts:
WINDOW: the ydgC window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ydgC, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,132 to 2,211 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ydgC once); 42,960 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 86% of genes, 0.63 bits on average (perplexity 1.9 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 23,612 calls, named 96%, 0.21 bits; shell 18,536 calls, named 78%, 1.04 bits; cloud 812 calls, named 20%, 3.78 bits. Outside an RGP 25,780 calls, named 92%, 0.23 bits; inside an RGP 17,180 calls, named 78%, 1.25 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 77 fork, 2 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.25 against 0.23 bits) and names fewer genes (78% against 92%); 17,180 of the 42,960 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 31 ("Arm DNA-binding domain-containing prote…") 1.46 bits, RGP 55%; column 36 (dcp) 1.22 bits, RGP 56%; column 43 (marB) 1.06 bits, RGP 64%. The 51 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 84%, 0.85 bits on average; the other 29 columns: named 91%, 0.26 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 1-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 0-72%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: ydgC "GlpM family protein". named 99%; 0.02 bits.
2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 0-72%. named 37-99% (mean 86%), fewest named at column 7, named 37%; most hesitant at column 31, 1.46 bits.
